title: Beatrix and the Asset
author: Jonah Winterbourne
blurb: Marguerite Marchetti, a whistle-blower living under four names, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
